- With the help of the jack, kee the rear axle raised, position the shock absorber and screw in the bolts without tightening them.

- Refit the rear wheel.

- Remove the vehicle from the lift.

1. The definitve tightening of the shock absorber fixing bolts should be carried out in the design load conditions.
